models.name: metrics
models.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT r.* FROM retail r CROSS JOIN basis_meta b WHERE b.edition='approved' AND r.InvoiceDate>=CAST(b.start_inclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.InvoiceDate<CAST(b.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND r.UnitPrice>0 AND (b.invoice_mode='net_signed' OR (UPPER(SUBSTR(r.InvoiceNo,1,1))<>'C' AND r.Quantity>0))), a AS (SELECT CustomerID,(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,(COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo))::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM eligible GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT c.CustomerID, (COALESCE(a.revenue_pence,0))::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COALESCE(a.invoice_count,0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.CustomerID=a.CustomerID ORDER BY c.CustomerID

tests.name: unique_customer
tests.sql: SELECT CustomerID FROM metrics GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1

config.description: Implement retail policy: sales_only excludes C invoices and nonpositive quantities, net_signed retains signed Quantity, both exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID. Keep all original rows, sum Quantity*UnitPrice in GBP as rounded integer pence, count DISTINCT qualifying InvoiceNo per customer. Retain every customer with zeros.

models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND InvoiceNo NOT LIKE '%C%'
    AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0 AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_list AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM data.customers
)
SELECT 
  cl.CustomerID,
  SUM(f.Quantity * f.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
FROM customer_list cl
LEFT JOIN filtered f ON cl.CustomerID = f.CustomerID
GROUP BY cl.CustomerID
ORDER BY cl.CustomerID

config.description: Edit this actual SQL to implement the declared adopted retail policy. Editable tests do not determine final content correctness.

models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH retail_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM json_table(data, '$.tables.retail.rows[*]' COLUMNS (
        InvoiceNo VARCHAR PATH '$.InvoiceNo',
        StockCode VARCHAR PATH '$.StockCode',
        Description VARCHAR PATH '$.Description',
        Quantity BIGINT PATH '$.Quantity',
        InvoiceDate TIMESTAMP PATH '$.InvoiceDate',
        UnitPrice DECIMAL(18,2) PATH '$.UnitPrice',
        CustomerID VARCHAR PATH '$.CustomerID',
        Country VARCHAR PATH '$.Country',
        SourceRow BIGINT PATH '$.SourceRow'
    ))
)
SELECT 
    d.CustomerID,
    SUM(r.Quantity * r.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
FROM retail_data r
JOIN json_table(data, '$.tables.customers.rows[*]' COLUMNS (
    CustomerID VARCHAR PATH '$.CustomerID'
)) d ON r.CustomerID = d.CustomerID
WHERE 
    -- Exclude nonpositive UnitPrice
    r.UnitPrice > 0
    -- Exclude missing CustomerID
    AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
    -- Apply sales_only: exclude C invoices (cancellations) and nonpositive quantities
    AND (r.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' OR r.Quantity > 0)
    AND r.Quantity > 0
GROUP BY d.CustomerID

models.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT r.* FROM retail r CROSS JOIN basis_meta b WHERE b.edition='approved' AND r.InvoiceDate>=CAST(b.start_inclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.InvoiceDate<CAST(b.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND r.UnitPrice>0 AND (b.invoice_mode='net_signed' OR (UPPER(SUBSTR(r.InvoiceNo,1,1))<>'C' AND r.Quantity>0))), a AS (SELECT CustomerID,(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,(COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo))::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM eligible GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT c.CustomerID, (COALESCE(a.revenue_pence,0))::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COALESCE(a.invoice_count,0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.CustomerID=a.CustomerID ORDER BY c.CustomerID

models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice
  FROM retail
  WHERE UnitPrice > 0
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
    AND InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%'
    AND Quantity > 0
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.CustomerID,
    ROUND(SUM(f.Quantity * f.UnitPrice * 100)::NUMERIC, 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
  FROM customers cm
  LEFT JOIN filtered f ON cm.CustomerID = f.CustomerID
  GROUP BY cm.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  COALESCE(revenue_pence, 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
  COALESCE(invoice_count, 0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY CustomerID

models.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT r.* FROM retail r CROSS JOIN basis_meta b WHERE b.edition='approved' AND r.InvoiceDate>=CAST(b.start_inclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.InvoiceDate<CAST(b.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND r.UnitPrice>0 AND (b.invoice_mode='net_signed' OR (UPPER(SUBSTR(r.InvoiceNo,1,1))<>'C' AND r.Quantity>0))), a AS (SELECT CustomerID,(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,(COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)+1)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM eligible GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT c.CustomerID, (COALESCE(a.revenue_pence,0))::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COALESCE(a.invoice_count,0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.CustomerID=a.CustomerID ORDER BY c.CustomerID

models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT r.InvoiceNo, r.CustomerID, r.Quantity, r.UnitPrice, r.InvoiceDate
    FROM retail r
    WHERE r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND r.UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (r.InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR r.InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
      AND r.Quantity > 0
),
distinct_invoices AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM qualifying
),
sales AS (
    SELECT r.CustomerID,
           SUM(r.Quantity * r.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
           COUNT(DISTINCT r.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
    FROM retail r
    INNER JOIN distinct_invoices di ON r.CustomerID = di.CustomerID
    WHERE r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND r.UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (r.InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR r.InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
      AND r.Quantity > 0
    GROUP BY r.CustomerID
)
SELECT c.CustomerID,
       COALESCE(s.revenue_pence, 0) AS revenue_pence,
       COALESCE(s.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count
FROM data.customers c
LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
ORDER BY c.CustomerID

Both exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID. models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT r.InvoiceNo, r.CustomerID, r.Quantity, r.UnitPrice
  FROM retail r
  WHERE r.UnitPrice > 0
    AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
    AND (r.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND r.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'c%')
    AND r.Quantity > 0
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT q.InvoiceNo, SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence
  FROM qualifying q
  GROUP BY q.InvoiceNo
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT r.revenue_pence FROM revenue r WHERE r.InvoiceNo = c.CustomerID
    ), 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) FROM qualifying q WHERE q.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    ), 0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
  FROM customers c
)
SELECT CustomerID, revenue_pence, invoice_count FROM customer_metrics

WITH qualified AS (

    InvoiceNo,

  FROM retail

    AND Quantity > 0

)
SELECT

FROM data.customers c
LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY c.CustomerID

config.description: Implement UCI retail policy: sales_only excludes C invoices and nonpositive quantities, net_signed retains signed Quantity. Both exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID. Keep all original rows. Sum Quantity*UnitPrice in GBP as rounded integer pence. Count DISTINCT qualifying InvoiceNo. Retain every customer from data.customers with zeros as needed.

models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH valid_invoices AS (
  SELECT * FROM retail
  WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL
    AND UnitPrice > 0
    AND InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%'
    AND InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'c%'
    AND Quantity > 0
  WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
  AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
),
customer_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.Quantity * r.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT, 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
  FROM data.customers c
  LEFT JOIN valid_invoices r ON c.CustomerID = r.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)

files.models/metrics.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT r.* FROM retail r CROSS JOIN basis_meta b WHERE b.edition='approved' AND r.InvoiceDate>=CAST(b.start_inclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.InvoiceDate<CAST(b.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND r.UnitPrice>0 AND (b.invoice_mode='net_signed' OR (UPPER(SUBSTR(r.InvoiceNo,1,1))<>'C' AND r.Quantity>0))), a AS (SELECT CustomerID,(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,(COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)+1)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM eligible GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT c.CustomerID, (COALESCE(a.revenue_pence,0))::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COALESCE(a.invoice_count,0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.CustomerID=a.CustomerID ORDER BY c.CustomerID
files.tests/unique_customer.sql: SELECT CustomerID FROM metrics GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1

data.meaning: UCI InvoiceNo starting C (case insensitive) is a cancellation; UnitPrice is GBP per unit. sales_only excludes C invoices and nonpositive quantities; net_signed retains signed Quantity including cancellations. Both exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID. Keep all original rows (no duplicate deletion), sum Quantity*UnitPrice in GBP and output rounded integer pence, count DISTINCT qualifying InvoiceNo. Retain every customer in data.customers with zeros as needed. Date interval is start inclusive/end exclusive using source local-naive timestamps.

Customer 18092 has InvoiceNo 539858 (rows 0,1,2 - 3 rows) and 541106 (rows 3,4 - 2 rows) = 2 distinct qualifying invoices.

config.description: Edit this actual SQL to implement the declared adopted retail policy. Editable tests do not determine final content correctness.

models.name: metrics
models.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT r.* FROM retail r CROSS JOIN basis_meta b WHERE b.edition='approved' AND r.InvoiceDate>=CAST(b.start_inclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.InvoiceDate<CAST(b.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND r.UnitPrice>0 AND (b.invoice_mode='net_signed' OR (UPPER(SUBSTR(r.InvoiceNo,1,1))<>'C' AND r.Quantity>0))), a AS (SELECT CustomerID,(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,(COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)+1)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM eligible GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT c.CustomerID, (COALESCE(a.revenue_pence,0))::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COALESCE(a.invoice_count,0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.CustomerID=a.CustomerID ORDER BY c.CustomerID

tests.name: unique_customer
tests.sql: SELECT CustomerID FROM metrics GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1

data.independent_checks: UCI InvoiceNo starting C (case insensitive) is a cancellation; UnitPrice is GBP per unit. sales_only excludes C invoices and nonpositive quantities; net_signed retains signed Quantity including cancellations. Both exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID. Keep all original rows (no duplicate deletion), sum Quantity*UnitPrice in GBP and output rounded integer pence, count DISTINCT qualifying InvoiceNo. Retain every customer in data.customers with zeros as needed. Date interval is start inclusive/end exclusive using source local-naive timestamps.
